A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the decade marked by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the decade marked by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During an encounter with the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]], the Padawan was [[Death/Legends|slain]], one of three Jedi meet their end on Ezzar's [[Lightsaber/Legends|blade]].<ref name="LFD" />
